entries.content: The Savannah is a fictional, fantasy land set in an African-coded landscape, where many species of anthropomorphic animals, some of which can't even be found in Africa (like tigers) live as competing tribes. The technology of said animals doesn't go much further than wooden huts and spears and most of them don't bother with more clothes than a loincloth or tunic. The climate is arid and quite unforgiving during the day, yet quite cold during the nights, much like a typical Afircan savannah biome.

Carnivores or Predators are a group of animals from the Savannah who exclusively eat meat and so are organized in small tribes or clans of hunters, warriors and warmongers. A small portion of more peaceful Carnivores can be found near bodies of water, where they can fish.
Herbivores or Prey are animals of The Savannah who exclusively eat plants and fruit, mostly organizing themselves in big, nomadic herds or setting down as farmers in tribal societies.
